kb_proposals: The étalé topology on Jet M X = Σ x, Germ (𝓝 x) X is a SCOPED instance (Benzecri.etaleTopology): Mathlib has no topology on Filter.Germ, and a global one would be an orphan on a Mathlib type. Inside namespace Benzecri it is active; use continuous_jet (y ↦ jet y g continuous for EVERY g) and isOpen_etaleBasic; IsOpen ↔ IsEtaleOpen is isOpen_iff_isEtaleOpen.

IsCoveringMap at this pin is ∀ x, IsEvenlyCovered f x (f ⁻¹' {x}); build it with IsCoveringMap.mk _ (fun _ => G) trivialisations (fibre G with ⊥ topology introduced by letI inside the proof); Trivialization is Bundle.Trivialization (open Bundle).
Variables made explicit with `variable (G X M) in` keep their DECLARATION order (M X G here), not the order written in the `variable` command.
